## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /packs/media/{mediaToken}` — Retrieve media content using an authentication token.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve a specific Cloudbeds data record by ID.
- `GET /wp-content/themes/cloudbeds-rebrand/assets/js/blocks/{blockId}/style.scss` — Get CSS styling for a specific Cloudbeds block.
- `GET /wp-json/cloudbeds/v1/customer-info` — Retrieve customer information from Cloudbeds.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update a specific Cloudbeds data record.
- `POST /attribution_tracking/conversions/assign` — Assign a conversion for attribution tracking.
- `POST /v1/putitem` — Create or update an item in Cloudbeds.

### Media (2)
- `GET /embed/medias/{mediaId}` — Retrieve details for a specific media item.
- `GET /embed/medias/av86rp6b5t/swatch` — Get a swatch for a specific media item.

### Config (1)
- `GET /config/cloudbeds.com/config.json` — Download the Cloudbeds configuration file.
